job.title: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM

tailoring.headline: Senior Berater SAP CX – SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for global enterprises such as Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end integration of PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven techno-functional consultant driving business analysis, user story creation and solution design for B2B/B2C e-commerce. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and AI-assisted development. Holds SAP Commerce Cloud certification and a valid German work permit.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
cover_en.hook: I am excited by the opportunity to join your team because of your leading position in SAP CX implementations and the innovative work you do in field-service and customer-service solutions. With more than five years of hands-on experience building SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and functional expertise that matches the senior consultant role.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product, catalog and pricing, for Rockwell Automation, and maintained core Hybris modules for Shell.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using DataHub, Hotfolders and Profisee, ensuring seamless integration with ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), optimized database queries and provided production support, guaranteeing high availability and performance.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026 – I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
cover_de.hook: Die führende Position Ihres Unternehmens im Bereich SAP CX und die innovativen Projekte im Feldservice- und Kundenservice-Umfeld begeistern mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen für Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefes technisches und funktionales Know-how mit, das exakt zu der Senior-Berater-Rolle passt.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Lösungen für Rockwell Automation und pflegte zentrale Hybris-Module bei Shell.

bullets.label: API- und Integration
bullets.text: Entwickelte OCC-REST-Web-Services und baute PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit DataHub, Hotfolders und Profisee, um nahtlose Anbindungen an ERP- und MDM-Systeme zu gewährleisten.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierte Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte sie in stabilen SAP-Commerce-Lösungen um.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments im SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) durch, optimierte Datenbank-Abfragen und leistete Production-Support für hohe Verfügbarkeit und Performance.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026 – ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meine Beiträge zu Ihren Projekten zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Your firm’s reputation as a top SAP CX consultancy, combined with a strong focus on innovative field-service and customer-service solutions, aligns perfectly with my passion for delivering end-to-end e-commerce and integration projects. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help your clients achieve seamless digital experiences and operational excellence.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise to drive successful SAP CX projects at a leading consultancy that values innovation and customer success.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Senior Berater SAP CX role and would love to discuss how I can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Berater SAP CX FSM/CS/CM
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Berater SAP CX FSM/CS/CM position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute immediately to your projects.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application.
